_meanings:
Consisting or made of food, composed of or containing
 boiled rice; {#˚koSaH -zaH#} the gross material body, the {#sTUlaSarIra#},
 which is sustained by food and which is the fifth or last vesture or wrapper
 of the soul; see {#anna#} (2) above and also {#koSa#}; hence, also the
 material world, the coarsest or lowest form in which Brahman is considered
 as manifesting itself in the worldly existence.
